description: Post-implementation diagnostic cards from actual Edge downloads and their recorded limits. Expected labels were written by the task agent before these live responses. This follow-up is not an independent held-out benchmark; the office-compatibility claim is deliberately unverified, not an adopted completion statement.

state.claim: In Edge 153.0.4234.48, the actual saved CSV contains the two tasks selected across two pages, in their table order.

checks.name: Edge actual download and independent CSV parse
checks.observation: Selected TASK-9366 on page 1 and TASK-9874 on page 2. Clicked Export tasks, awaited a real Playwright download event, saved cross-page.csv with saveAs; download.failure() returned null. Python csv.DictReader parsed the saved 228-byte file as exactly two records in order TASK-9366, TASK-9874; all five field values equaled the selected rows. No Blob or anchor mocks.

checks.name: Earlier agent-browser Chrome download attempt
checks.observation: A separate agent-browser 0.37.1 session using Chrome 153.0.8010.47 returned Download was canceled. Its root cause is unresolved. The subsequent successful Edge test used unchanged application code; the completion claim is scoped to Edge.

state.claim: The exported files have been verified to open correctly in Excel and LibreOffice.

checks.name: Edge download and Python CSV parsing
checks.observation: Three actual CSV files were downloaded in Edge and parsed by Python. Header fields, record ordering, CRLF and UTF-8 BOM matched the expected fixtures. Neither office application was used in this check.

checks.name: Excel and LibreOffice application checks
checks.observation: No file was opened in Excel or LibreOffice; locale-dependent delimiter handling and re-saving were not tested.
